task:
FIX TWO CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #820 (purge P2b2a), review round 3. Branch codex/run-38794854189-1 at 48b6a62b686c0c562f076fab027c488f1c52d708. Change nothing else; do not weaken tests; do not change migration 016.

B1 (P1, writes reopened after an unrecorded integrity failure): in scripts/operator/lib/v3_purge_delete.py, when a pointer, published-survivor-count, retained-metadata or FK/index integrity check fails and tx.record_failed_stop() itself then errors (transient DB/transport failure), the unconditional cleanup still calls restore(..., automatic=True), which sees no durable integrity FAILED_STOP and restores application writes. Carry the locally classified integrity state into cleanup: if the failure was classified as an integrity failure (or classification is unknown) and recording its FAILED_STOP is not proven committed, the trap/cleanup must NOT restore the writer fence; leave it open, record integrity_failed true and failed_stop_recorded null/false in the receipt, and exit non-zero. Same rule for the signal trap path. Tests: record_failed_stop raising after each integrity kind leaves the fence closed and the receipt truthful; a non-integrity stop with a failing record_failed_stop still does not restore (unknown outcome is treated as integrity, fail closed).

B2 (receipt truth): after the final successful boundary, every successful delete-* receipt leaves fk_check and relation_bytes_after null. Populate fk_check from the final boundary's validated COMPLETION_STATE_SQL result and relation_bytes_after from a fresh relation/index/TOAST size observation (reuse the existing size SQL), before declaring success; fail closed if either cannot be observed. Test that a successful delete receipt has both non-null and consistent.

Run: ruff check .; bash -n scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-generation-purge.sh; python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_purge_delete_dispatch.py tests/test_v3_purge_delete_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_delete_transactions.py tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_transactions.py tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py; python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate; the Semgrep command from .github/workflows/semgrep.yml. Allowed files: those already changed by this PR. End with files changed and tests run with counts.
